description: Phase-30 RESEARCH-ONLY value/state candidate-recall OVERLAY for vault/CDP/liquidation/accounting/post-op-invariant systems. Read ONLY by scripts/value_state_recall_sample.py (un-wired). Closes the P28 Badger gap where the awarded post-op comparison bug (LeverageMacroBase._doCheckValueType) was never queued. Inclusion requires TWO signals (value/state name + value/state context); NO external/public visibility gate (value/state bugs are frequently internal/library/view math). Generic verbs need >=2 strong context signals. is_gate:false research_only:true routes_in_production:false routed_manifest_ids:[].
_notes: name_signal: strong=names_strong; generic=names_generic (needs >=2 strong context sub-signals); structural=name unmatched but contract matches cdp_vault_contract_regex AND a value/comparison param present. context_signal sub-signals: value/comparison param (value_param_regex), context term (context_terms), cdp/vault contract. Noise: interface contracts refused; pure/view fn with no value-comparison evidence refused; plain ERC20 transfer/approve wrapper refused unless accounting/liquidation context. Internal/private fns require a caller_context hint.
